name: QA 2109
description:
PCP QA Test No. 2109

Verify pmproxy /logger/meta endpoint rejects malformed metadata

records without crashing (network-layer regression for vulns 1, 9, 10)



Adapted from PoC exploits provided by TIM Security Red Team.
